input.quote: 11.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11 gives Corio (our side, as licensee/payer) no right to terminate for convenience during the five-year initial term: Section 11.1 only permits non-renewal at the end of the initial or a renewal term, and Section 11.2 limits termination to material breach or insolvency. Under the detection guidance, the absence of any customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation, and it also fails the fallback (60-90 days' notice). Commerce One likewise has no mid-term convenience right, which is acceptable to us, so the redline only adds a Corio convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid recurring fees and no early-termination penalty, and confirms no vendor convenience right during the term. The new subsection is inserted after 11.2; existing 11.3 (Effect of Termination) renumbers accordingly.

proposal.summary: Add a Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid recurring fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The five-year term currently locks us in with no exit other than for breach or insolvency, so we have added a convenience termination right on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid recurring fees, consistent with our playbook position. If you need a longer runway we can move to sixty (60) days' notice.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One. In such event, Commerce One shall refund to Corio, within thirty (30) days after the effective date of termination, the pro-rata portion of any prepaid maintenance and support, access or other recurring fees attributable to the period after such effective date, and no early termination fee, penalty or acceleration of unpaid fees shall apply. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term or any renewal term.
